title: Original WAResolvable native Promise fulfillment and rejection
oracle: Actual constructed WAResolvable, original resolve/reject/resolveWasCalled, and its own realm-native Promise observed before settlement. Native Promise first-settlement semantics preserve initial fulfillment/rejection across later resolve. reject delegates through resolve(Promise.reject(reason)), so resolveWasCalled becomes true after rejection. Ordered native observer checkpoints expose pending then fulfilled/rejected states. Rejection projection is explicitly the Sentinel name/message observation contract, not a vendor error conversion.

trials.domainEvidence: No gate reads found in both selected original source modules. Missing cr6640 implementation remains a closure gap; explicit null fixture chooses real original Promise fallback. Value/reason domains are unbounded and the generated probes are characterization only.

All functions in each dependency module are scanned; exact export and caller reachability is not proven.

exclusions: Missing archived cr6640 source; explicit null environment fixture chooses actual Promise fallback to realm global Promise. Original substitution/bootstrap is not established
No gate reads in the selected WAResolvable/Promise closure is not global configuration independence; actual callers and missing provider remain outside acceptance
Rejection is exercised only before settlement with an observer installed on actual instance.promise. The native Promise must be an own data property; no getter/thenable/function fixture replaces it

Repeated reject and reject after fulfillment are deliberately unexecuted: source always creates Promise.reject(reason) before passing it to an already-settled native resolver, so a source-derived unhandled orphan rejection risk needs a dedicated controlled diagnostic. It is not a passing first-wins rejection test
Each case constructs a fresh instance. No reset/retry API or reuse after rejection is invented; later resolve cannot recover the same settled Promise
Rejected reason identity and stack are not asserted; inspect/await name/message projection is Sentinel observation behavior. Falsy/null/undefined and empty messages are retained explicitly
isSettled data flag is not read because general instance-property inspection is outside current capture-only native-Promise seam
Promise polyfills for absent allSettled/finally, subclassing, arbitrary thenable assimilation, cancellation, all asynchronous schedules and pending cleanup remain unexercised
Generated values/reasons and two settlement sequences are finite characterization, not exhaustive input or temporal coverage
Alternate variants, containers, production scheduling, accounts, network, ABProps readiness rejection and named-library parity remain unexercised
